title: Parametric Insurance
tagline: Prediction market everything. Create contracts for any data that is present on the internet.
description: Prediction markets for everything. Create smart contracts around any data available on the internet — prices, APIs, weather, sports, elections, social metrics, and on-chain activity. Turn real-world and digital information into permissionless markets that aggregate knowledge, price uncertainty, and reveal collective truth through incentives.
how_its_made: This project is built as a high-performance prediction market stack combining cryptography, smart contracts, and low-latency execution. The core protocol is implemented using Hardhat for rapid Solidity development, testing, and deployment. We integrate TLSNotary to generate verifiable cryptographic proofs of off-chain internet data, allowing real-world APIs and websites to be safely referenced on-chain without trusted oracles. For high-speed trading and market responsiveness, we use Nitrolite to enable off-chain execution and fast state transitions, dramatically reducing latency and gas costs while preserving on-chain security guarantees. The result is a hybrid system that securely bridges internet data with scalable, real-time prediction markets.
